result.topic_en: Numerical computation of all seven roots (real and complex, with log-moduli and arguments) of the equation x^7 − 3x^2 + 2 = 0, with auxiliary trigonometric and logarithmic substitutions for finding the roots.

methods.what: Complete numerical list of the seven roots of x^7 − 3x^2 + 2 = 0, real and complex, with log of modulus and argument in degrees, minutes, seconds
Constant Delta = 3^7/2^5 used in a substitution
Substitution for the positive real root 0,93726 via auxiliary quantities a, b, c with relations equal to Delta, and x as 7th root of 2/a
Recovering the positive root as a seventh root
Substitution for the negative real root −0,77987 via auxiliary quantities with relations equal to Delta, and −x as 5th root of 3/a
Recovering the negative root as a fifth root
Trigonometric parametrisation of complex roots x = r(cos θ + i sin θ): auxiliary quantity lambda in terms of sines of multiples of θ
Modulus of a complex root expressed through the argument θ
